about: Lichdom: Battlemage is a game of unbridled power and magic. As a battlemage gifted with both, you will use your skill at crafting spells to combat evil forces in a fast-paced, explosive fight for justice.
When the wicked overlord known as Shax rips your closest loved one from the world, you set out on a
journey to hunt him down. Before you embark on your quest for vengeance, a wizard grants you
unlimited magical powers and designates you “Dragon,” the most powerful battlemage on earth.
Armed with this great power – and a set of magical bracers – you are now able to craft thousands of
spells that can be used as you wish. Unfortunately, killing Shax turns out to be no easy feat, for he has
gathered armies of undead, convinced an evil cult to work for him, and has summoned demons from the abyss – all of which you must fight and destroy….
This product supports the following languages: English
